I reviewed all of lines 1–133 and checked them against the rubric on repeated proof machinery. I did not search the other source roots, because the candidate repetitions are short and local to this file. There are two candidates.

1. `rangeSingleton` and `rangeIcc` have similar `mem_support_toFun` proofs. Each is a short `rw` followed by one existing lemma (`singleton_injective.eq_iff` or `Icc_eq_singleton_iff`). `rangeIcc` also has the union and `not_or` steps. A shared helper would be a thin wrapper and would not make this clearer.

2. `card_Ico`, `card_Ioc`, `card_Ioo` and `card_Iio` each rewrite with an existing cardinality lemma and then with `card_Icc` or `card_Iic`. These are one-line uses of existing API, not repeated nontrivial reasoning.

The `card_Icc`, `card_uIcc` and `card_Iic` proofs each call the previous result once. They are short, so I count them as routine reuse.

I found no repeated nontrivial proof block that would justify a new shared lemma.
